license_policy.description: Hard constraint, not a score. Unknown or ambiguous licenses go to manual review and are never auto-selected.

kenney.notes: No public search API. Download a pack zip by hand, then `lopodev assets add-pack <zip> --provider kenney --name <pack>`; the pack's own license file is checked.

quaternius.notes: No public API. Many character packs are rigged and animated (glTF). Add downloaded packs with `lopodev assets add-pack`.

kaykit.license_evidence: License file shipped in each pack
kaykit.notes: No public API; itch.io downloads. Add downloaded packs with `lopodev assets add-pack`.

polyhaven.credit: Asset search powered by Poly Haven (polyhaven.com)
polyhaven.notes: Official public API, free incl. commercial use; requests must carry an identifying User-Agent; products surfacing live API content show a 'Powered by Poly Haven' credit. Models are high-detail: check triangle budgets.

ambientcg.notes: Official v2 JSON API; materials download as zip per resolution.

polypizza.notes: API requires a key (unauthenticated requests return 401) and per-asset licenses differ (CC0 and CC-BY). No adapter until its response schema is verified with a key; download individual models by hand and add them with an explicit --license.

opengameart.notes: No documented API; licenses vary per submission (including GPL and CC-BY-SA). Manual only: verify the individual license, then add with `--license <SPDX> --license-evidence <url>`.
